newsitem.title: USA: Digital Solutions says wins settlement.
newsitem.headline: Digital Solutions says wins settlement.

text.p: Digital Solutions Inc said Thursday it completed a settlement in its suit against LNB Investment Corp, Bruce and Linda Goldman, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and other individuals
The company said the defendants agreed to pay $676,000, of which $401,000 has been received, without admitting or denying the allegations in the complaint.
The company said the balance is secured and due from LNB and the Goldmans on or before August 4.
The company previously received $330,000 from LNB, bringing the total settlement to $1.006 million.
The company said the settlement will be booked as equity in the fiscal quarter ending September 30, and will have no effect on its earnings.
The company said the suit arose out of the transfer and subsequent sale of 525,000 shares of its common stock, which was posted as collateral for a loan to be made by LNB.
